title.en: An Act to Convert the Townships of the Province of Ilocos Sur and the Subprovince of Abra Into Municipalities, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
All townships of the Province of Ilocos Sur and the subprovince of Abra may be converted into
municipalities under Act Numbered Eighty-two whenever such townships shall decide to adopt this form of
municipal government.

For the purpose of carrying this Act into effect in the townships of Ilocos Sur and Abra, a
plebiscite shall be held on the first Tuesday after the first Monday of the month of July, nineteen hundred and
sixteen, in order to determine the will of the people as to whether or not the township is to be converted into a
municipality. A majority of votes shall decide the plebiscite, at which all the present electors of the townships
shall be entitled to vote.

Whenever two or more townships shall decide for their conversion into municipalities and the
distance between them shall not be greater than fifteen kilometers, then such townships may consolidate if
they shall so decide.

Any township of Ilocos Sur or Abra which shall have decided for conversion into a municipality
by means of the plebiscite herein provided for and which shall have the number of inhabitants required by Act
Numbered Eighty-two and its amendments, shall ipso facto be converted into such a municipality from and
after January first, nineteen hundred and seventeen.

This Act shall take eifect on its passage.
Enacted, February 4, 1916.
